Rodriguez Custom eBikes with Automatic Shifting
Rodriguez eBike Galleries
Rodriguez Disruptor™ Custom eBike
Disrupting Conventional eBike Thinking
Equipped with the first and only automatic, electric shifting system designed for an e-bike, Shift-E™. It’s a unique system from a company that puts riders first. Whether it's the daily commute, keeping up with your friends, or topping that hill outside your door with less effort, the Rodriguez Disruptor™ will take your riding to a new level.
• Trouble free automatic (or manual) electronic shifting
• Hand crafted in Seattle just for you
• No compromise on comfort - It's just your size!
• Power to extend any ride, conquer any hill
• Commute more - Car Less
• Lighter weight - easy transport
• Award winning technology for smooth acceleration
• Anything else....Just ask!
Full bike from $6,499
See full specifications below - Start an order Advanced, Lighter, Faster, Smarter, Proven
Paint and Decals Contact Us
Photo Gallery Sizing Information
Testimonials How to Order Quick facts:
“If you’re thinking about an e-bike, test ride it with the motor turned off. If you can’t pedal it around, you don’t want it!”
- A Rodriguez eBike customer
You can run up to 54mm wide tires. The Disruptor™ is American made from high quality, butted, super durable steel tubing. Every Disruptor™ comes with a pair of hand built wheels with a 1-year no hassle warranty . It's the most comfortable, versatile eBike available. It's is perfect for a rainy day commute and our fit is guaranteed.
